from django.test import SimpleTestCase

from .services.pricing import calculate_price


class PricingRegressionTests(SimpleTestCase):
    def test_enterprise_discount(self):
        customer = type("Customer", (), {"is_enterprise": True})()
        self.assertLess(calculate_price(customer, "growth"), Decimal("299.00"))
